class.name: SteamCloud
class.brief_description: Reads and writes files in the active app's Steam Cloud storage.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.cloud]. Names are portable relative paths using ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores, hyphens, and forward slashes. Each path component must be nonempty and cannot end in a period or use a reserved Windows device name. Whole-file transfers are limited by [constant MAX_FILE_BYTES]. A successful write observes local Steam completion. Cross-device synchronization follows Steam's separate sync lifecycle.

method.name: begin_write_batch
method.description: Opens an app-wide Steam Cloud hint for a related group of Remote Storage writes, deletes, or direct disk writes in Steam Auto-Cloud paths. Keep [member SteamCloudWriteBatchResult.value] alive and await each submitted asynchronous write before closing it. [constant ERR_BUSY] indicates that a batch is already open. Each write keeps its own result and Steam controls synchronization.

method.name: delete_file
method.description: Deletes the named file from local Steam Remote Storage. Steam propagates the deletion through its sync lifecycle. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] if a submitted transfer still reserves the name, or [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND] if the file is absent.

method.name: download_shared
method.description: Use [code]await cloud.download_shared(handle)[/code] to receive a [SteamSharedCloudFileResult] from a shared file belonging to the active Steam AppID. [param handle] is a canonical unsigned decimal UGC handle, such as one returned by [method share]. [param max_bytes] limits bytes copied into the result and must be between 1 and [constant MAX_FILE_BYTES]. Steam may download the content to its own cache before its size can be validated. Supply [param expected_name] to require an exact filename match. A valid portable filename is required for every download. Use [method download_shared_file] to retain an operation for cancellation.

method.name: download_shared_file
method.description: Starts a bounded download with the same validation as [method download_shared] and returns its retained operation. The handle remains reserved until Steam reports completion and the local Steam cache entry is closed.

method.name: file_info
method.description: Returns local metadata for the named file. An absent file reports [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND].

method.name: files
method.description: Returns one page of local file metadata in Steam's current enumeration order. [param offset] is a nonnegative zero-based index. [param limit] must be between 1 and [constant MAX_PAGE_FILES]. An offset at or beyond the last file returns an empty successful page. The file list can change between requests.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the active client exposes Steam Remote Storage on the main thread.

method.name: is_enabled_for_account
method.description: Returns the signed-in account's Steam Cloud sync preference. Returns [code]false[/code] when the query is unavailable.

method.name: is_enabled_for_app
method.description: Returns the Steam Cloud sync preference for the active AppID. Returns [code]false[/code] when the query is unavailable.

method.name: quota
method.description: Returns total capacity and available bytes for the signed-in account's active app storage.

method.name: read
method.description: Use [code]await cloud.read(name)[/code] to receive a [SteamBytesResult]. Inspect [member SteamResult.ok] before reading [member SteamBytesResult.value]. Use [method read_file] to retain an operation for cancellation.

method.name: read_file
method.description: Starts a whole-file read and returns its operation. An existing empty file completes successfully with zero bytes. A missing file completes with [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND].

method.name: share
method.description: Use [code]await cloud.share(name)[/code] to receive a [SteamStringResult] containing the opaque UGC handle as a canonical unsigned decimal string. Use this with bytes intended to be shared, such as a leaderboard replay. A published handle can remain usable after local file deletion. Use [method share_file] to retain an operation for cancellation.

method.name: share_file
method.description: Submits a share of an existing local file up to [constant MAX_FILE_BYTES] bytes and reserves its filename until Steam settles the request. Returns the retained typed share operation. An absent local file reports [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND]. Steam can still publish the file after the caller cancels observation.

method.name: write
method.description: Use [code]await cloud.write(name, bytes)[/code] to receive a [SteamResult] for local Steam write completion. Use [method write_file] to retain an operation for cancellation.

method.name: write_file
method.description: Submits a whole-file write and returns its operation. [param bytes] must contain between 1 byte and [constant MAX_FILE_BYTES] bytes. The service copies the submitted bytes and holds the file name until Steam settles the transfer.

signal.name: local_files_changed
signal.description: Emitted after Steam applies local file changes for an app with dynamic Cloud sync enabled. [param changes] is a read-only array of detached [SteamCloudChange] snapshots. [param truncated] is [code]true[/code] when some changes could not be included. Refresh affected save data when receiving a truncated batch.

constants.constant: Maximum size of a whole-file transfer in bytes. The limit is 16 MiB.
Maximum number of local file snapshots returned by one [method files] request.
